### Load require libraries
```{r, echo=FALSE}
library(devtools)
library(magrittr)
```

### Document, install and load the package
```{r}
.libPaths()
document()
install()
load_all()
test()
```

### Load required libraries for the package
```{r}
libs2use <- c(
  "lobstr", "haven", "RSQLite", "RPostgres",
  "DBI", "odbc", "R6", "RMariaDB",
  "RMySQL", "getPass"
)

use_package("tidyverse", type = "depends")
libs2use %>% purrr::walk(use_package)
```

##### 📦 renv Quick Commands

```{r}
renv::init() # init project
renv::snapshot() # save packages
renv::restore() # restore from lockfile
renv::status() # check differences
renv::install("pkg") # install package
renv::update() # update packages
renv::clean() # remove unused
```
💡 Commit `renv.lock` for reproducibility

##### Test data generate 
```{r}
library(DBI)
library(RSQLite)

con <- dbConnect(SQLite(), "tests/testthat/fixtures/test.db")

dbWriteTable(con, "mtcars", mtcars)

dbDisconnect(con)

saveRDS(mtcars, "tests/testthat/fixtures/test.rds")

test1 <- mtcars
test2 <- mtcars
save(test1, test2, file = "tests/testthat/fixtures/test.rda")

haven::write_xpt( mtcars, path = "tests/testthat/fixtures/test.xpt")
system("zip tests/testthat/fixtures/test.zip tests/testthat/fixtures/test.rds")
system("tar -cvf tests/testthat/fixtures/test.tar tests/testthat/fixtures/test.rds")

```
